title: Engine doc fixes and config-checked replays
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: Replays now record a hash of their seed and config, so editing a replay's arena or tank settings fails verification even when the match would play out the same. Replay format is now 3; older files still load. Two decision records now carry dated corrections about where the tank code lives and how the viewer draws, and the command-line runner now says Coastal Agentics Arena.
next: Tank Arena rules once the spec clears Nye's gate.
